proposals.current_fact: Neutral OLD_MAN mapping, empty semantic_effects; gloss includes foolish/odd.
proposals.proposal: Review with existing opinion permission, as for little-shit. Reference to an older man is valid; the character judgment may be added to a neutral source. Preserve affectionate use and do not force every use into hostile-insult classification.
Drunkenness is well supported. Cheerful/slightly sloppy are colour in the current gloss, not universal semantic entailments; avoid treating them as supported facts.

limits: Primary media reports dominate; broadcaster identity is not independent lexical-frequency research.
UK/US lexical labels coexist with actual Australian usage; do not infer foreign-sounding or uncommon status automatically.
Some witnesses establish related noun/compound/inflected forms; form notes preserve those limits.
No failed search proves fabrication; blocked URLs have no assigned support.
Publication and interview dates are witnesses, not earliest-term dates.
